relationships.subject: Valproic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraperitoneal injection of VPA (300 mg/kg) efficiently attenuated mechanical allodynia in rats with NP

relationships.subject: Valproic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: VPA exerted anti-inflammatory effects by downregulating proinflammatory cytokines

relationships.subject: Valproic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: VPA treatment inhibited nuclear factor-κB (NF-κB) p65 nuclear expression

relationships.subject: Valproic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: VPA suppressed SNL-induced phosphorylation of Janus Kinase 2 (JAK2) and signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3)

relationships.subject: Valproic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: regulates microglial function and suppresses spinal neuroinflammation via the STAT1/NF-κB and JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathways

relationships.subject: Valproic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: The anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects may have depended on changes in nuclear histone deacetylase 3 (HDAC3) expression following VPA treatment

relationships.subject: Valproic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: promoted the polarization of microglia towards the M2 phenotype

key_findings: VPA attenuated SNL-induced mechanical allodynia, shifted cytokines to anti-inflammatory and promoted M2 microglial polarization.
VPA reduced NF-κB p65 nuclear expression, raised acetylated STAT1 and suppressed JAK2/STAT3 phosphorylation.
